title: Pre-dawn landslide buries homes in Ngingir, Calanogas; 7 dead, 4 missing
summary: A rain-induced landslide hit Barangay Ngingir (also spelled Ngirngir), Calanogas, at about 2:30 a.m. on 10 July 2026 after two days of heavy rain linked to Super Typhoon Inday. Police first reported 5 dead, 2 injured and 6 missing; the toll rose to 7 dead and 4 missing after a sixth body was recovered from a river in neighbouring Malabang and a seventh victim was found on 10 July. Calanogas was placed under a state of calamity on 11 July; the 4 missing were still unaccounted for as of 12-13 July.

title: Five children drown in a pond at Marawi permanent shelter site
summary: Five children aged 7 to 11 drowned around 11 a.m. to noon on 16 April 2026 while swimming in a water-impounding pond at Phase 2 of the Permanent Shelter in Barangay Panoroganan, Marawi City; they had been using a discarded refrigerator as a float and went under in the deep part while trying to reach a companion. An 8-year-old girl was rescued. All five were declared dead on arrival at a Marawi hospital. The Inquirer placed the site in Barangay Kilala and dated it 15 April.

title: Faulty wiring fire destroys part of 103rd Brigade barracks at Kampo Ranao, Marawi
summary: A fire that began about 3 p.m. on 25 October 2025 burned for roughly 45 minutes and destroyed part of the hilltop barracks of the Philippine Army's 103rd Infantry (Haribon) Brigade at Kampo Ranao, Marawi City. The brigade's civil-military operations officer attributed it to faulty electrical wiring. No casualties were mentioned in the report excerpt.

title: Early-morning fire guts an establishment in Marawi Poblacion
